title: Choose Grey Retention's visual world
question: Original, white-label-ready operating system. Keep selected direction, choose alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Signal Loom
options.lineage: Jacquard drafting grids and campaign production tables
options.thesis: Every campaign becomes one woven record, with strategy, audience, copy, design, approval, and send state crossing on the same field.
options.viewport: Slim navigation rail, wide monthly campaign weave, and fixed evidence inspector joined by one live brand-colored thread.
options.risk: Grid becomes decorative if crossings do not encode real campaign state.

raised.raise: One-pixel ruling and marginal annotations now make every relationship exact.
Priority uses a strict magnitude scale instead of louder containers.
Every transformation receives a named, inspectable state.
One active thread visibly connects an operator action to affected campaign fields.

options.label: Proof Table
options.lineage: Creative-director light tables and marked campaign proofs
options.thesis: Campaign work lives as evidence under review, with every note, source, revision, and approval physically attached to its proof.
options.viewport: Campaign proofs occupy a generous central table; calendar strip and context drawers frame the active artifact rather than competing with it.
options.risk: Familiar creative-tool composition can feel less distinctive without disciplined proof annotations.

options.label: Campaign Concourse
options.thesis: Campaigns become live departures: scheduled rows, fixed operational columns, and unmistakable state changes.
options.viewport: Dense live schedule fills the workspace while a compact inspector opens beneath or beside the selected campaign row.
options.case: Excellent scheduling clarity and operational rhythm; weaker fit for brand-rich creative work and white-label expression.
options.risk: Hard transport identity can overpower tenant branding and copy creation.

options.label: Adaptive Specimen
options.thesis: White-label identity becomes an inspectable set of live axes that reshape every product surface without forks.
options.viewport: Oversized tenant identity and campaign state demonstrate live branding axes above a precise operational grid.
options.case: Strong white-label mechanism and systemic clarity; less immediate campaign-planning identification.
options.risk: Typography can become the subject instead of retention operations.

options.label: Centre-Rail Edition
options.thesis: Campaign evidence and operator guidance sit in exact margins around the active draft.
options.viewport: Twin work columns surround a keyed centre rail; notes occupy wide margins.
options.case: Excellent reading and annotation system; insufficient command of live schedules and visual campaign assets.
options.kept: One-pixel ruling and marginal annotation discipline.
options.risk: Dense operational data can become bookish and slow to scan.

options.label: Retention Atlas
options.thesis: Campaign opportunities become ranked signals plotted across a month.
options.viewport: A plotted month field reveals clusters, gaps, and selected opportunities.
options.case: Useful prioritization metaphor; campaign editing and white-labeling become secondary.
options.kept: Strict magnitude scale for priority without noisy cards.
options.risk: Spatial metaphor hides familiar calendar and workflow affordances.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: Operators cut raw context into campaign blocks and assemble a temporary monthly structure.
options.viewport: Campaign blocks are assembled in a spatial month with visible transformation states.
options.case: Strong transformation storytelling; weak trust, density, accessibility, and white-label fit for daily operations.
options.risk: Surreal material obscures ordinary work and increases rendering cost.

options.label: Drawcord System
options.lineage: transforming garments and hidden tension channels
options.thesis: One controlled action gathers scattered campaign context into a ready operational shape.
options.viewport: A central campaign plane changes shape as one action thread connects context, copy, audience, and approval.
options.case: Memorable action model; garment identity does not match daily retention operations closely enough.
options.kept: One active thread connecting action to consequences.
options.risk: Literal textile treatment becomes ornamental across dense admin screens.

canonCard.label: Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: Conventional sidebar SaaS dashboard, executed cleanly and predictably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, KPI cards, chart row, and recent campaigns table.
canonCard.risk: Easy to operate but indistinguishable from retention and analytics competitors.
